description.text: Entry Pack '08, the second Entry Pack for newcomers, released on 30 November 2007. It renewed the first pack's artwork, attacks and deck lists, again with three ready-built 30-card half decks led by Torterra, Infernape and Empoleon, of three different types, and a coin, damage counters and markers, a how-to-play sheet and a practice playmat. Entry Pack '08 DX, released the same day, added a fourth deck led by Raichu, a first-steps guide book, acrylic damage counters and a sticker sheet, all in a small trunk-shaped case.
